column1: Digital Catalog Agent - Conceptual Understanding Quiz
column2: Educational quiz testing WHY and HOW, not just WHAT - designed to teach while testing
column4: medium

column2: Question
column4: Opt2

column2: Why did we choose to target small Indian retailers specifically?
column4: They face digital literacy and language barriers

column2: Why is voice input critical for this project's target audience?
column4: Many users have low literacy and can't type easily

column2: Why do we support 5 regional Indian languages instead of just English?
column4: English-only tools exclude millions of potential users

column2: Why did we choose React over other frameworks?
column4: Component reusability, huge ecosystem, and fast performance

column2: Why use Vite instead of Create React App?
column4: Vite is 10-100x faster in development with HMR and ES modules

column2: Why does the backend run on port 3001 instead of 3000?
column4: Port 3000 is often occupied by other dev servers

column2: Why use Tailwind CSS instead of traditional CSS?
column4: Utility-first approach ensures consistency and faster development

column2: Why is Prisma chosen as the ORM?
column4: Type-safe queries, auto-completion, and excellent DX

column2: Why host on Supabase instead of setting up our own PostgreSQL?
column4: Managed database with built-in auth, RLS, and zero DevOps

column2: Why use bcrypt for password hashing instead of storing plain text?
column4: Prevents password theft if database is compromised

column2: What security benefit does JWT provide over session cookies?
column4: Stateless authentication, no server-side session storage needed

column2: Why use Multer for file uploads?
column4: Handles multipart/form-data and provides file filtering

column2: Why deploy to Vercel instead of traditional hosting?
column4: Automatic scaling, edge deployment, and zero configuration

column2: Why have separate User, Product, and PaymentSettings tables?
column4: Normalization: reduces redundancy and maintains data integrity

column2: What problem does the One-to-Many relationship between User and Product solve?
column4: Each user owns multiple products but products belong to one user

column2: Why use CASCADE delete on the User-Product relationship?
column4: When user deletes account, orphaned products are auto-removed

column2: Why store payment data as JSON strings instead of separate tables?
column4: Flexible schema for varying payment methods without multiple columns

column2: Why use the Web Speech API instead of a third-party service?
column4: Native browser support, no API costs, works offline

column2: Why implement the Speech Synthesis API for text-to-speech?
column4: Accessibility for visually impaired users

column2: Why does Tamil STT mistake 'cancel' for 'cancer'?
column4: Phonetic similarity in Tamil pronunciation confuses the STT model

column2: Why implement local keyword fallbacks when AI APIs fail?
column4: Ensures app works even with no internet or API downtime

column2: Why use Perplexity instead of ChatGPT for product generation?
column4: Perplexity has web access and better structured outputs

column2: Why have Gemini as a fallback instead of just one AI service?
column4: High availability: if primary AI fails, app continues working

column2: Why does AI always output in English regardless of input language?
column4: Standardized database schema, easier exports to international platforms

column2: Why implement cleanAiResponse() to remove <think> tags?
column4: LLM reasoning pollutes product descriptions meant for customers

column2: Why limit image uploads to 5MB?
column4: Balance between quality and storage costs, prevents abuse

column2: Why use Base64 encoding for images?
column4: Embeds images directly in database without external file storage

column2: Why support 5 different export formats instead of just one CSV?
column4: Each platform (Amazon, Flipkart, Google) requires specific column formats

column2: What business problem does Shopify Auto-Sync solve?
column4: Merchants can sell both on their catalog site AND Shopify without double entry

column2: Why trigger Shopify sync on product creation automatically?
column4: Real-time inventory sync prevents overselling and outdated listings

column2: Why use fuzzy matching for voice product search?
column4: STT errors mean exact search fails, fuzzy matching handles typos

column2: Why implement local command translation arrays instead of AI?
column4: Instant navigation without API latency, works offline

column2: What problem does the useVoiceCommands hook solve?
column4: Centralizes voice logic, reusable across all pages

column2: Why support Hinglish and Tanglish mixing?
column4: Real Indian users naturally mix languages, ignoring this breaks UX

column2: Cascade deletion prevents orphaned data in the database
Storing passwords in plain text is secure if the database has a firewall
Using JWT means we must store session data on the server
Base64 encoding compresses images to save storage space
Web Speech API requires an internet connection to work
Supporting multiple languages increases the app's potential user base
AI fallback mechanisms improve application reliability
What is the main advantage of voice-first design for low-literacy users?
column3: They can speak naturally without typing

column2: Why is Prisma considered type-safe?
What does normalization achieve in database design?
Why use environment variables for API keys?
column3: Security - prevents exposing secrets in code

column2: What problem does connection pooling solve?
column3: Reuses database connections for better performance

column2: Why is Row Level Security important in multi-tenant apps?
column3: Ensures users only access their own data

column2: What is the purpose of the cleanAiResponse function?
column3: Remove LLM artifacts from customer-facing text

column2: Why implement authentication middleware for product APIs?
column4: Prevents unauthorized users from accessing/modifying others' products

column2: What advantage does serverless deployment on Vercel provide?
column4: Auto-scales with traffic, pay only for actual usage
